reviewScope: The complete eight-tool app-only contract for the two publicly federated UI resources. The internal Usage and Cost Explorer implementation is intentionally excluded from public federation. These tools must remain hidden from model selection.

tools.name: number_intelligence_analyze
tools.title: Analyze phone number
tools.description: Billable Number Intelligence summary. Each call performs a Telnyx Number Lookup that can incur lookup charges and affect account balance, then adds safe owned-number, messaging, and voice enrichment by default. Selected enrichments can make additional Telnyx API requests. The tool does not create, change, or delete phone-number resources. Portability and cached reputation are opt-in; reputation is always fresh=false.

tools.name: number_intelligence_batch_analyze
tools.title: Batch analyze phone numbers
tools.description: Billable batch Number Intelligence for pasted CSV/newline input. Each unique accepted number performs a Telnyx Number Lookup that can incur lookup charges and affect account balance; selected enrichments can make additional Telnyx API requests. Runs sequentially, caps the batch at 25, redacts outputs, and does not create, change, or delete phone-number resources.

tools.name: voice_monitor_dashboard
tools.title: Open Voice Monitor
tools.description: Open a single read-only Telnyx voice monitor workspace with preloaded dropdowns, active calls, call timelines, status lookup, and recording search.

tools.name: voice_monitor_list_options
tools.title: Load Voice Monitor options
tools.description: Discover app-friendly dropdown options for connections, call-control applications, and voice numbers so users do not need to paste IDs.

tools.name: voice_monitor_active_calls
tools.title: List active calls
tools.description: List active calls for a selected Call Control Application ID. If omitted, discovers a bounded set of call-control applications and queries each; it never assumes a global active-calls endpoint.

tools.name: voice_monitor_call_timeline
tools.title: Read call timeline
tools.description: Read Telnyx GET /call_events with supported filters. Prefer call_leg_id or call_session_id/application_session_id; connection-only searches default to the last 24 hours.

tools.name: voice_monitor_call_status
tools.title: Get call status
tools.description: Read call status from GET /calls/{call_control_id}. This is read-only and does not issue Call Control commands.

tools.name: voice_monitor_recordings
tools.title: Search recordings
tools.description: Search Telnyx recordings for post-call investigation. Recording URLs, transcripts, and metadata are redacted in output.
